title: Ambient equivariant ind-sheaves of the common-stage constructible heart
statement:
Fix a finite-field datum $D=(p,a,q,k_0,k)$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne p$, and an algebraic closure $\Omega$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$. For each finite-type $k_0$-scheme $X_0$, let $X=X_0\times_{k_0}k$ and let $\mathcal C_X=\operatorname{Sh}_c(X,\Omega)$ be the actual common-stage constructible heart [def-weil-constructible-heart]. Let $F_X$ be geometric Frobenius inverse image on this heart, restricted from the actual common-stage derived pullback [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. Use a size-equivalent small presentation $\mathcal C_X^s$ and its ordinary ind-category. Extend a heart functor $L$ to $\operatorname{Ind}(L)$ by left Kan extension of $L$ followed by Yoneda, along Yoneda. Its comparison on representables is the inverse of the Kan unit. Define
$$\mathcal W_X^{\mathrm{amb}}=\operatorname{IsoAlg}(\operatorname{Ind}(F_X)).$$
These are all invertible Frobenius pairs in the ind-category of the underlying constructible heart; no finiteness condition is imposed on the Frobenius orbit. The category of constructible Weil sheaves is precisely the existing heart-carrier category [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex], and its embedding in $\mathcal W_X^{\mathrm{amb}}$ is induced by Yoneda and the inverse Kan unit. This embedding is fully faithful. The existing Weil heart is abelian, and $\mathcal W_X^{\mathrm{amb}}$ is Grothendieck abelian.

For a morphism $f_0:X_0\to Y_0$ between finite-type $k_0$-schemes, define inverse image on these categories by restricting actual common-stage pullback to the heart and extending it to ind-objects. Normalize the pullback composition isomorphism on every rationalized integral representative by the integral composition comparison of [lem-pod-integral-pullback-composition], with its specified finite reductions. The equality $\operatorname{Fr}_X\circ f=f\circ\operatorname{Fr}_Y$ and these normalized composition isomorphisms give $f^*F_Y\simeq F_Xf^*$. Restrict this square to hearts, transport it through the small presentation, and extend it to ind-objects by its specified Yoneda components. These characterizations uniquely determine all comparison arrows. The resulting functor $f^*:\mathcal W_Y^{\mathrm{amb}}\to\mathcal W_X^{\mathrm{amb}}$ has a right adjoint $f_*$. For an open immersion $j_0$ it also has a left adjoint $j_!$. The direct image is additive; the open left adjoint is the exact extension-by-zero operation. The adjunctions determine both operations and their Weil actions up to unique compatible isomorphism. No derived category of fixed pairs is substituted for the category of Weil complexes.
